newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb gets FDA clearance for ReNu.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb gets FDA clearance for ReNu.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb said Thursday it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market ReNu MultiPlus Solution, an all-in-one soft contact lens cleaning product.
The company said it expects to launch ReNu MultiPlus Solution by the end of the third quarter with a "strong" marketing effort.
The product will compete in the chemical disinfecting segment.
The company said daily use of ReNu eliminates the need for a separate enzymatic cleaner or daily cleaner for many contact lens wearers.
It contains Hydranate, an ingredient the company said promotes daily removal of the protein that builds up on contact lenses from a wearer's tear film.
The company said ReNu does not need to be washed off with a separate solution before the lens is worn. All the cleaning functions of the solution are combined in one bottle.
